description.en: New Jersey is a state located in both the Mid-Atlantic and Northeastern regions of the United States. Located at the geographic hub of the heavily urbanized Northeast megalopolis, it is bordered to the northwest, north, and northeast by New York State; on its east, southeast, and south by the Atlantic Ocean; on its west by the Delaware River and Pennsylvania; and on its southwest by Delaware Bay and Delaware.
description.zh-CN: 紐澤西州，是美國第四小以及人口密度最高的州，邮政縮寫NJ。其命名源自位於英吉利海峽中的澤西島；其暱稱為“花園州”。
description.zh-TW: 紐澤西州，是美國第四小以及人口密度最高的州，郵政縮寫NJ。其命名源自位於英吉利海峽中的澤西島；其暱稱為“花園州”。
